output.reason: [ev-b55698b84a79] deprecates authorization `type: opa` and says it still works until a future removal. The schema check confirms that spec.kafka.authorization.type exists on kafka.strimzi.io Kafka in both releases [ev-5d73e704055d][ev-d758a7cb99a4]. So the right exposure is a Kafka resource whose authorization type equals opa. The proposed condition compares against the string "\"opa\"", which includes literal quote characters, so it would never match a real `type: opa` value. The value must be the bare literal opa.

correction.statement: Kafka resources (kafka.strimzi.io) that set spec.kafka.authorization.type to opa are exposed to the deprecation of Open Policy Agent authorization. It still works in 0.46.0 but will be removed in the future. Use `type: custom` authorization instead.
